bio: This restaurant has plenty of history behind it, given that it occupies a building located next to the city’s famous “hanging houses” which was once used as a store house. The surprising interior, featuring minimalist and modern furnishings, provides the backdrop for contemporary cuisine that reinterprets well-known local dishes. Once seated, you can choose between two tasting menus with a wine-pairing option, one a shorter 4-course version (only available Wednesday to Friday), the other a longer 6-course menu....
